sources.title: 3.4 magnitude earthquake shakes Enterprise, Northern Utah
Nov. 14: Earthquake measuring 2.1 struck region close to Little Lake, CA
Magnitude 3.4 earthquake strikes about 7 miles southeast of Huntsville

en.title: 3.4 Magnitude Earthquake Shakes Northern Utah on November 15
en.dek: A 3.4 magnitude earthquake struck near Enterprise, Utah, while a 2.1 magnitude quake struck near Little Lake, California, on November 14 and 15, 2026.
facts: ABC4 Utah reported a 3.4 magnitude earthquake shook Enterprise, Northern Utah, on 15 November 2026 at 01:52 UTC.
KUTV stated the 3.4 magnitude earthquake struck about 7 miles southeast of Huntsville.
The Sacramento Bee reported a 2.1 magnitude earthquake struck a region near Little Lake, California, on 14 November 2026 at 01:37 UTC.
body: ABC4 Utah reported a 3.4 magnitude earthquake shook Enterprise, Northern Utah, on 15 November 2026 at 01:52 UTC, and KUTV stated the event struck about 7 miles southeast of Huntsville.
The Sacramento Bee reported a 2.1 magnitude earthquake struck a region near Little Lake, California, on 14 November 2026 at 01:37 UTC, which occurred in the region.
The two seismic events were reported by ABC4 Utah and the Sacramento Bee within a few days in November 2026.
en.context: No source provided information explaining why earthquakes occur in Utah or California.

ko.title: 2026년 11월 15일, 북부 유타주서 규모 3.4 지진 발생
ko.dek: 14일과 15일, 유타주 엔터프라이즈 인근과 캘리포니아주 리틀레이크 인근서 규모 3.4와 2.1 지진 각각 발생
facts: ABC4 유타가 15일 오전 01:52 UTC에 엔터프라이즈, 북부 유타주서 규모 3.4 지진 발생 보도
KUTV가 규모 3.4 지진이 헛츠빌로부터 동남쪽 7마일 지점에서 발생했다고 보도
《Sacramento Bee》가 14일 오전 01:37 UTC에 캘리포니아주 리틀레이크 인근서 규모 2.1 지진 발생 보도
body: ABC4 유타에 따르면 2026년 11월 15일 01시 52 UTC에 북부 유타주 엔터프라이즈에서 규모 3.4의 지진이 발생했으며 KUTV는 이 지진이 헌츠빌에서 남동쪽으로 약 7마일 떨어진 곳에서 발생했다고 보도했다.
새크라멘토 비는 2026년 11월 14일 01시 37 UTC에 캘리포니아 리틀 레이크 근처 지역에서 규모 2.1의 지진이 발생했다고 보도했다.
두 지진 사건은 2026년 11월 며칠 간격으로 ABC4 유타와 새크라멘토 비에 의해 보도되었다.

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and is too broad.
The dek is too long and attempts to summarize events that should be presented as facts.
The facts list contains vague phrasing ('close to the Lake County region') not explicitly supported by the sources, and the final sentence is evaluative.
The body paragraphs contain filler and lack the required sentence variation (no paragraph has a longer sentence with two clauses).
The body ends with an evaluative summary ('Both outlets reported the seismic events by their measured magnitudes and general locations').
The context section introduces speculation ('Earthquakes are common in both Utah and California due to regional fault lines') which is not supported by any source.
The structure does not adhere to the required opening pattern (open paragraphs with actor, number, document, or date, not the same noun as the previous paragraph).
